Zero-touch karting video + telemetry pipeline.

## Global options

| Option | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--config`, `-c` |  | Path to config.toml |
| `--verbosity` | `info` | Log level: quiet \| info \| debug. `debug` also surfaces low-level telemetry-decoder chatter (e.g. libxrk 'Unknown units'). |

## mt camera

Camera SD-card utilities (list / selective download).

## mt camera get

    mt camera get [OPTIONS] [NAMES]...

Download videos from the camera into the library (all new, or only the named ones).

| Argument | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `NAMES` | no | Video filenames from `mt camera list` (omit to download all new) |

| Option | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--force` | false | Re-download and refresh files already ingested |

| `--all` | false | Include videos already downloaded (default: only new) |

## mt google-auth

    mt google-auth

Authorize YouTube uploads: opens Google's consent screen, then saves the
refresh token. Uploads nothing - `google-setup` only creates the OAuth
client, and until this runs the first upload is what triggers consent.

## mt google-setup

    mt google-setup [OPTIONS]

Configure the Google side of `mt publish` by driving the Cloud Console
(consent screen + Desktop OAuth client + client_secret.json download).
Sign-in is the one manual step: do it in the window that opens.

| Option | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--troubleshoot` | false | Snapshot every Console step into <library>/gcp_troubleshoot/ to understand/refine the procedure when Google shifts the UI |

## mt gui

    mt gui

Launch the desktop review GUI (Gate 1 content review + Gate 2 render plan).

## mt ingest

    mt ingest [OPTIONS]

Copy new camera videos and MyChron sessions into the library (download only).

| Option | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--source` | `all` | Which sources to ingest: all, camera, mychron |
| `--rs3` | false | First drive Race Studio 3 to download from the MyChron |
| `--rs3-only` | false | Only drive the Race Studio 3 download; skip camera/mychron file ingest |
| `--troubleshoot` | false | RS3 diagnostics (implies --rs3-only): snapshot every step, dump the control tree, unhide already-downloaded sessions, scroll the list, 30s waits |
| `--force` | false | Re-download and refresh files already ingested |

## mt join

    mt join [OPTIONS] DAY

Join camera-split video segments (GoPro/DJI ~4 GB rollovers) into one video.

| Argument | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `DAY` | yes | Day (YYYY-MM-DD) |

| Option | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--videos`, `--clips` |  | Comma-separated source-name substrings to join as ONE session (e.g. 0065,0066). Omit to auto-detect all split runs. |
| `--gap-s` | `8.0` | Max seconds between segments to treat as one recording |
| `--dry-run` | false | Show what would be joined |

## mt plan

    mt plan [OPTIONS] DAY

Build the render-plan queue (review Gate 2) - one item per synced video.

| Argument | Required | Description |

| `DAY` | yes | Day (YYYY-MM-DD) |

| Option | Default | Description |

## mt publish

    mt publish [OPTIONS] [DAY]

Upload rendered videos to YouTube (as configured, default private).

| Argument | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `DAY` | no | Day (YYYY-MM-DD); default all |

| Option | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--dry-run` / `--no-dry-run` | false | Show what would be uploaded |
| `--force` | false | Re-upload renders even if already published (a fresh video) |
| `--video`, `--clip` |  | Only publish renders whose file name contains this substring |

## mt render

    mt render [OPTIONS] [DAY]

Render telemetry overlays onto synced videos (or an edited --plan).

| Argument | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `DAY` | no | Day (YYYY-MM-DD); default all |

| Option | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--force` / `--no-force` | false | Re-render already rendered videos |
| `--resolution`, `--res` |  | Output resolution: hd\|fhd\|2k\|4k (default from config) |
| `--scan-race-end` / `--no-scan-race-end` | false | Trim the video after the engine shutdown (default from config) |
| `--video`, `--clip` |  | Only render videos whose name contains this substring (re-renders them) |
| `--from` |  | Render only from this video time (MM:SS or seconds) - a short sample to validate the trim without rendering the whole video |
| `--to` |  | With --from, render only up to this video time (else up to the race-end cut) |
| `--codec` |  | Override the video codec (e.g. libx264, h264_nvenc) |
| `--crf` |  | Override quality (lower = higher quality; libx264 CRF / nvenc CQ) |
| `--plan` |  | Execute an edited render plan (work/render_plan.json) |

## mt run

    mt run [OPTIONS]

Full pipeline: MyChron download -> ingest -> correlate -> sync -> render [-> publish].

| Option | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--publish` / `--no-publish` | false | Also upload to YouTube |
| `--rs3` / `--no-rs3` | false | Trigger Race Studio 3 download (default: [rs3] enabled) |
| `--resolution`, `--res` |  | Output resolution: hd\|fhd\|2k\|4k (default from config) |

## mt scan

    mt scan [OPTIONS]

List NEW camera + telemetry content (read-only), correlated by video.

Nothing is copied or written - this is the pre-download review gate.
Telemetry with no matching video is flagged 'orphan': it is still committed
on ingest, it just yields no render item.

| Option | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--json` | false | Machine-readable JSON (for the review GUI) |

## mt slice

    mt slice [OPTIONS] DAY RANGES...

Cut slices out of a rendered overlay video into out/slices/.

| Argument | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `DAY` | yes | Day (YYYY-MM-DD) |
| `RANGES` | yes | Time ranges like 12:01-14:02, 1:02:03-1:04:00 or 721-842 (seconds) |

| Option | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--video`, `--clip` |  | Which rendered video (substring) when the day has several |
| `--copy` / `--no-copy` | false | Keyframe-snapped stream copy (instant, cuts up to a few seconds early) |
| `--publish` / `--no-publish` | false | Also register the slice and upload it to YouTube |

## mt sync

    mt sync [OPTIONS] [DAY]

Align videos with telemetry (auto, or manual --video with --video-start or --lap/--at).

| Argument | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `DAY` | no | Day (YYYY-MM-DD); default all |

| Option | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--video`, `--clip` |  | Manual mode: video source name |
| `--video-start` |  | Manual mode: exact UTC start of the video (ISO 8601) |
| `--lap` |  | Manual mode: telemetry lap number you start at video time --at |
| `--at` |  | Manual mode: video time (MM:SS) of the --lap start/finish crossing |
| `--force` / `--no-force` | false | Re-sync videos that already have a sync |

## mt telemetry

MyChron telemetry utilities (list / download).

## mt telemetry get

    mt telemetry get [OPTIONS] [NAMES]...

Download MyChron sessions via Race Studio 3 and ingest them. No camera involvement.

| Argument | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `NAMES` | no | Session filenames from `mt telemetry list` (omit to download all new) |

| Option | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--rs3` / `--no-rs3` | true | First drive Race Studio 3 to pull sessions off the MyChron |
| `--troubleshoot` | false | RS3 diagnostics; skips the file ingest step |
| `--force` | false | Re-ingest files already downloaded (only files already on disk; RS3 hides sessions already pulled off the device) |

## mt telemetry list

    mt telemetry list [OPTIONS]

List MyChron .xrk sessions in Race Studio 3's data dir. Copies nothing.

| Option | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--all` | false | Include sessions already ingested (default: only new) |
| `--json` | false | Machine-readable JSON (for the review GUI) |

## mt watch

    mt watch [OPTIONS]

Zero-touch daemon: poll for new camera/telemetry material and run the pipeline.

| Option | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--publish` / `--no-publish` | false | Also upload to YouTube on each run |
| `--once` / `--no-once` | false | Run a single pass and exit |
| `--install` / `--no-install` | false | Install as a Windows Scheduled Task (runs at logon) |
